title: QuotesDone IT Engineer Knowledge v1
purpose: Make the IT seat competent at ITS OWN JOB -- diagnosing a live system -- rather than at reciting security theory. The founder's build order of 9 Sep 2026 named the tasks: monitor everything in the app and the website, catch a bug when a customer registers or a comparison report that is lagging, and watch for attacks and malware reaching us from customers or suppliers.
generated_at_load: cron.job + cron.job_run_details -> QD-ITE-LIVE-SCHEDULER, the real scheduler baseline
pg_proc -> QD-ITE-LIVE-DEFINER-SURFACE, how many routines run as their owner and who may execute them
public.ops_knowledge -> QD-ITE-LIVE-CORPUS-INVENTORY, what the seat can actually retrieve
public.model_policy_by_identity + public.model_rate -> QD-ITE-LIVE-MODEL-PAIR, this seat's pair with prices read from the rate table so they cannot drift

extends_not_supersedes.statement: Not one it_security_deep row is rewritten, retired or contradicted by this pack. That layer holds the security half -- OWASP LLM against this codebase, auth and identity, the RLS and grant surface, the edge-function attack surface, PCI and PDPL mapping, MITRE threat modelling, an auto-refreshed live-posture binding. This pack holds the diagnostic half. fn_it_engineer_assist reads both, so the seat retrieves across the union rather than from a fork.

never_runtime: scripts/kb/it_engineer_knowledge_retrieval_eval.mjs holds the evaluation questions and their expected records. It is a SCRIPT, not a record file, it is not named in runtime_files, and the loader refuses any path that is not records/*.jsonl. The estate has a documented defect where exam answers leaked into the corpus an agent retrieves and 557 rows had to be quarantined; keeping the questions in executable code rather than in a data file is what stops that recurring here.

epistemic_contract.authority_effect: none on every record, CHECK-pinned in the table. A record may DESCRIBE authority. It may never CARRY it.
epistemic_contract.banned_shapes: No record in this pack states a CVE identifier, a GitHub Security Advisory identifier, a CVSS score, a version-specific vulnerability or patch claim, or an assertion about the patch level this estate is running. This session cannot read a vulnerability feed, so every one of those would be invented. The loader scans every record for all six shapes and refuses the whole run on a hit; the eval proves the guard bites by feeding it strings that carry each shape, because zero refusals cannot distinguish a dead guard from a clean corpus.
epistemic_contract.the_word_is_not_banned: The word CVE and the concept of a published advisory are allowed and used. A record explaining how to determine whether an advisory reaches this estate is exactly what the seat needs. The identifier is banned; the noun is not.
epistemic_contract.live_state_is_not_stored: Where the answer is a live measurement -- what is failing now, what a log says, which deploy is current -- the record says which query, log or endpoint holds it rather than holding a snapshot that will be wrong by the time it is read. The five generated records are the exception and each says on its face that it states the position as at the load run.
